\[
x^2+y^2=4y
\]
Substitute \(x=2t,\ y=\sqrt3 t+2\):
\[
(2t)^2+(\sqrt3 t+2)^2=4(\sqrt3 t+2)
\]
\[
4t^2+3t^2+4\sqrt3t+4=4\sqrt3t+8
\]
\[
7t^2=4
\]
\[
t=\pm \frac{2}{\sqrt7}
\]
The direction vector of the line is \((2,\sqrt3)\), whose length is \(\sqrt{4+3}=\sqrt7\). Thus the segment length is
\[
\left|\frac{2}{\sqrt7}-\left(-\frac{2}{\sqrt7}\right)\right|\sqrt7
= \frac{4}{\sqrt7}\sqrt7=4.
\]
\[
\boxed{4}
\]
